newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ indexed bond yields 4.84 percent at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ indexed bond yields 4.84 percent at tender.

text.p: The allocation yield on New Zealand government inflation-indexed February 2016 bonds at Thursday's tender was 4.84 percent, the Reserve Bank said.
The tender was for NZ$50 million of the bonds, which have a 4.50 percent coupon.
In the last tender on November 28, only NZ$49 million of the NZ$50 million inflation-indexed February 2016 bonds tendered were accepted. They yielded 4.86 percent.
Settlement date for the latest tender is February 18.
